value_label_status: official questionnaire and Codebook categories reviewed; frequency counts omitted
construct: Father's current marital status reported by respondent; common-law marriage is counted as married per questionnaire interviewer note. Relation filter: parentID=1 (Father); ca003=1 (Biological Parent).
value_semantics: Categorical parent-record measure; retain relation, wave, route and source codes; do not aggregate across parents or mix with respondent-level fields.
caveat: Single-wave parent/family-context measure. The questionnaire asks about the father's current status, not the respondent's own marital history or a retrospective childhood exposure. Parent module is a long roster, not one row per respondent. Link by respondent ID and parentID. For 2013 also require ca003=1 (biological parent); for 2015 parentID=1 is respondent's biological father and parentID=2 is respondent's biological mother. Do not include spouse's parents, in-laws, step/adoptive parents or other relatives. Preserve question routing and structural missingness. These are discovery candidates only; any respondent-level analysis requires a prespecified relation-specific estimand.
